source_checks.notes: Reviewed publication metadata, the four-stage attack chain, Inno temporary staging, callback lifecycle and parameter table, independent offer outcomes, child-payload timing, all three monetization branches, mitigation guidance, official hunt, hunting note and source-provided ATT&CK mapping.

Reviewed DeviceNetworkEvents purpose and MDE prerequisite plus every required and projected field used by hunting.kql, including RemoteUrl, remote endpoint, initiating-process fields, InitiatingProcessUniqueId and Timestamp/DeviceName/ReportId event identity guidance.

Reviewed the T1071.001 definition and used it only for the source-observed HTTP callback behavior; downstream persistence and resource-hijacking techniques were deliberately excluded from the rule scope and name.
Reviewed the Kusto has operator syntax and token semantics used by the source-published first predicate; no unsupported parsing behavior is claimed.
Reviewed the Kusto has_any operator syntax and term-list semantics used by the source-published second predicate; no threshold, sequence or correlation semantics are inferred.

mechanism.rationale: Section 2 and PDF page 3 identify the user-controlled execution boundary, Inno-style runner, per-offer coordinator, HTTP callback contract, inherited user context and downstream capability while explicitly rejecting a vulnerability inference and limiting the query to URL observability.

timeline.rationale: Section 3 and PDF pages 1-3 separate the 2026-11-03 publication, 2026-11-04 analysis and unknown campaign dates, then preserve the source-supported relative sequence because the investigation does not disclose complete event timestamps or timezone.

root_cause.rationale: Section 2 and PDF pages 2-3 identify deceptive unofficial-installer execution and delegated runner processing as enabling conditions, state the relevant trust boundary and explicitly retain advertising, search poisoning, redirect path and per-victim intent as unknown rather than inventing a delivery root cause.

execution_flow.rationale: Section 3 and PDF page 3 provide a causal five-stage sequence from user execution through temporary staging, independent offer processing, callback and separately scoped downstream behavior, distinguishing source-observed campaign steps from what one hunt match can prove.

impact.rationale: Section 4 and PDF pages 2-3 and 8 separate source-confirmed proxy, distributed-compute and utility monetization from potential endpoint consequences, preserve legitimate-product context and reject installation, privilege-escalation or compromise conclusions from the callback alone; victim count and per-host outcomes remain unavailable.

evidence.rationale: Section 5 and PDF pages 2, 4 and 8 map source facts, official schema, Kusto semantics and ATT&CK to C###/S### ledgers; they isolate two analyst inferences, single-investigation dependence, unknown server-side meanings, absent raw events and unmeasured field completeness.

lab_plan.rationale: Section 7, validation.md and PDF page 7 specify an authorized Windows/MDE environment and versions to retain, an internal listener, a harmless paired-marker positive, three semantic negatives, proxy-path comparison, expected artifacts, success/rejection/failure criteria, cleanup and the explicit not-executed state.
